title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c 164, sec. 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter reradings in the billing months of November, and December, 1986 and January, 1987. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company's and, (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchase of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the fillings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
